arabic: + نَسْأَلُ وَنَتَضَرَّعُ إِلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا اَلسَّيِّدُ اَللهُ اَلآبُ ضَابِطُ الْكُلِّ: وَالِابْنُ الْوَحِيدُ الْقُدُّوسُ: خَالِقُ الْكُلِّ وَمُدَبِّرُهُمْ: وَالرُّوحُ الْقُدُسُ الْمُحْيِي: اَلثَّالُوثُ الْقُدُّوسُ الَّذِي تَجْثُو لَهُ كُلُّ رُكْبَةٍ مَا فِي السَّمَوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الأَرْضِ: نَسْأَلُكَ يَا رَبُّ اسْمَعْنَا وَارْحَمْنَا.

+ مِنْ أَجْلِ السَّلَامَةِ الْعَالِيَةِ: وَتَآلُفِ سَائِرِ الْبِيَعِ الَّتِي فِي الْعَالَمِ: وَالأَدْيِرَةِ وَالْمَجَامِعِ الْمُقَدَّسَةِ: وَالسُّكَّانِ فِيهَا وَالْقِيَامِ بِأَحْوَالِهَا: يَا اَللهُ تَحَنَّنْ عَلَى خَلِيقَتِكَ وَنَجِّهَا مِنْ كُلِّ سُوءٍ: نَسْأَلُكَ يَا رَبُّ اسْمَعْنَا وَارْحَمْنَا.

+ يَا مَنْ بِقُدْرَتِهِ دَبَّرَ حَيَاةَ الإِنْسَانِ قَبْلَ خَلِيقَتِهِ: وَصَنَعَ لَهُ الْمَوْجُودَاتِ بِحِكْمَتِهِ: وَزَيَّنَ السَّمَاءَ بِالنُّجُومِ: وَالأَرْضَ بِالنَّبَاتَاتِ وَالأَشْجَارِ وَالْكُرُومِ وَالأَوْدِيَةِ: أَنْتَ الآنَ يَا مَلِكَنَا اقْبَلْ طَلِبَاتِ عَبِيدِكَ الْوَاقِفِينَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ الْقَائِلِينَ: نَسْأَلُكَ يَا رَبُّ اسْمَعْنَا وَارْحَمْنَا.

+ يَا اَللهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْقُدُّوسُ الَّذِي خَلَقَ الإِنْسَانَ عَلَى صُورَتِهِ وَمِثَالِهِ: وَجَعَلَ فِيهِ نَفْسًا حَيَّةً عَاقِلَةً نَاطِقَةً: ارْحَمْ يَا رَبُّ جِبِلَّتَكَ الَّتِي خَلَقْتَهَا وَتَحَنَّنْ عَلَيْهَا: وَأَرْسِلْ عَلَيْنَا رَحْمَتَكَ مِنْ عُلُوِّ قُدْسِكَ وَمَسْكَنِكَ الْمُسْتَعِدِّ: نَسْأَلُكَ يَا رَبُّ اسْمَعْنَا وَارْحَمْنَا.

+ يَا مَنْ خَلَّصْتَ عَبْدَكَ نُوحًا الْبَارَّ: وَنَجَّيْتَهُ مِنَ الطُّوفَانِ هُوَ وَبَنُوهُ وَنِسَاؤُهُمْ: وَأَيْضًا الْحَيَوَانَاتِ الطَّاهِرَةَ وَغَيْرَ الطَّاهِرَةِ لِأَجْلِ تَجْدِيدِ الأَرْضِ مَرَّةً أُخْرَى: نَسْأَلُكَ يَا رَبُّ اسْمَعْنَا وَارْحَمْنَا.

+ أَيُّهَا الْبَارِي رَازِقُ الْكُلِّ: نَجِّ شَعْبَكَ مِنْ طُوفَانِ بَحْرِ الْعَالَمِ الزَّائِلِ: وَارْفَعْ عَنْهُمْ كُلَّ مَكْرُوهٍ: وَكُلَّ الْحَيَوَانَاتِ أَيْضًا وَسَائِرَ الطُّيُورِ أَعْطَاهَا قُوتَهَا: لِأَنَّكَ تُعْطِي لِلْبَهَائِمِ رِزْقًا وَلِفِرَاخِ الْغِرْبَانِ قُوتًا: نَسْأَلُكَ يَا رَبُّ اسْمَعْنَا وَارْحَمْنَا.

+ يَا مَنْ ضَيَّفَ عِنْدَهُ عَبْدَهُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ رَئِيسَ الآبَاءِ: وَاتَّكَأَ عَلَى مَائِدَتِهِ وَبَارَكَ فِي زَرْعِهِ: أَنْتَ الآنَ يَا مَلِكَنَا اقْبَلْ طِلْبَةَ عَبِيدِكَ وَكَهَنَتِكَ الْوَاقِفِينَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ: وَتَرَاءَفْ عَلَى الْعَالَمِ وَخَلِّصْ شَعْبَكَ مِنْ كُلِّ شِدَّةٍ: وَحُلَّ فِيهِمْ وَسِرْ بَيْنَهُمْ: نَسْأَلُكَ يَا رَبُّ اسْمَعْنَا وَارْحَمْنَا.

+ نَطْلُبُ إِلَيْكَ يَا رَبُّ لِكَيْ تَحْرُسَنَا مِنْ جَمِيعِ الشُّرُورِ: وَتَرَاءَفْ عَلَى خَلِيقَتِكَ وَجَمِيعِ شَعْبِكَ: لِأَنَّ أَعْيُنَ الْكُلِّ تَتَرَجَّاكُ وَأَعْطِهِمْ طَعَامَهُمْ فِي حِينِهِ: يَا مُغَذِّيَ كُلِّ ذِي جَسَدٍ: يَا عَوْنَ مَنْ لَا عَوْنَ لَهُ: يَا رَجَاءَ مَنْ لَا رَجَاءَ لَهُ: نَسْأَلُكَ يَا رَبُّ اسْمَعْنَا وَارْحَمْنَا.

+ أَيُّهَا النَّاظِرُ إِلَى الْمُتَوَاضِعِينَ بِعَيْنِ عِنَايَتِكَ الَّتِي لَا تَغْفُلُ: وَخَلَّصْتَ يُوسُفَ مِنِ امْرَأَةِ سَيِّدِهِ وَجَعَلْتَهُ مَلِكًا عَلَى مِصْرَ وَأَحْوَالِهَا: وَأَجَزْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَيَّامَ الشِّدَّةِ: فَأَتَى إِلَيْهِ إِخْوَتُهُ وَأَبُوهُ يَعْقُوبُ وَسَجَدُوا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ: وَأَخَذُوا مِنْهُ حِنْطَةً لِقُوتِ بَنِيهِمْ وَمَوَاشِيهِمْ: نَحْنُ الْجَمِيعُ أَيْضًا نَخْضَعُ لَكَ بِرُؤُوسِنَا وَنَسْجُدُ مَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ: وَنَشْكُرُكَ يَا خَالِقَنَا وَرَازِقَنَا عَلَى هَذَا الْحَالِ وَفِي كُلِّ حَالٍ وَمِنْ أَجْلِ سَائِرِ الأَحْوَالِ: وَنَجِّنَا يَا اَللهُ مِنْ كُلِّ شِدَّةٍ: نَسْأَلُكَ يَا رَبُّ اسْمَعْنَا وَارْحَمْنَا.

+ أَيُّهَا الإِلَهُ كَلِمَةُ الآبِ الْفَاعِلُ فِي النَّامُوسِ وَالأَنْبِيَاءِ وَالْعَهْدِ الْقَدِيمِ وَمُكَمِّلُهُمْ: خَلِّصْ شَعْبَكَ مِنْ كُلِّ ضِيقَةٍ: وَدَبِّرْ حَيَاتَهُمْ كَحَسَبِ إِرَادَتِكَ الصَّالِحَةِ: وَارْفَعْ عَنَّا كُلَّ الْقَحْطِ وَالْبَلِيَّةِ: نَسْأَلُكَ يَا رَبُّ اسْمَعْنَا وَارْحَمْنَا.

+ يَا مَنْ عَالَ الشَّعْبَ الإِسْرَائِيلِيَّ أَرْبَعِينَ سَنَةً فِي طُورِ سِينَاءَ: وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُمْ بُيُوتٌ وَلَا مَخَازِنُ: أَنْتَ الآنَ يَا سَيِّدِي احْفَظْ شَعْبَكَ وَعُلْهُمْ: وَبَارِكْ فِي مَنَازِلِهِمْ وَمَخَازِنِهِمْ بِالْبَرَكَاتِ السَّمَائِيَّةِ: نَسْأَلُكَ يَا رَبُّ اسْمَعْنَا وَارْحَمْنَا.

+ يَا مَنْ قَبِلْتَ طِلْبَةَ إِيلِيَّا التَّشْبِيتِيِّ عِنْدَمَا أَمْطَرَتِ السَّمَوَاتُ وَأَنْبَتَتِ الأَرْضُ: وَبَارَكْتَ فِي كَيْلَةِ الدَّقِيقِ وَقِسْطِ الزَّيْتِ فِي بَيْتِ الأَرْمَلَةِ: أَقْبِلْ طِلْبَةَ شَعْبَكَ بِصَلَوَاتِ قِدِّيسِيكَ وَأَنْبِيَائِكَ الأَطْهَارِ: نَسْأَلُكَ يَا رَبُّ اسْمَعْنَا وَارْحَمْنَا.

+ يَا اَللهُ تَرَاءَفْ عَلَى الْعَالَمِ بِعَيْنِ الرَّحْمَةِ وَالرَّأْفَةِ: وَبَارَكْ فِي كَيْلِ غَلَّاتِهِمْ وَمَخَازِنِهِمْ وَفِي الْقَلِيلِ الَّذِي عِنْدَهُمْ: وَأَصْعِدْ مِيَاهَ الأَنْهَارِ كَمِقْدَارِهَا وَهَبِ اعْتِدَالًا لِلأَهْوِيَةِ: وَنِيلَ مِصْرَ بَارِكْهُ فِي هَذَا الْعَالَمِ وَكُلَّ عَامٍ: وَفَرِّحْ وَجْهَ الأَرْضِ وَعُلْنَا نَحْنُ الْبَشَرَ: نَسْأَلُكَ يَا رَبُّ اسْمَعْنَا وَارْحَمْنَا.

+ يَا مَنْ قَبِلْتَ تَوْبَةَ أَهْلِ نِينَوَى عِنْدَمَا صَامَ الْجَمِيعُ: وَقَبِلْتَ إِلَيْكَ اعْتِرَافَ اللِّصِّ الْيَمِينِ عَلَى الصَّلِيبِ: هَكَذَا نَحْنُ اجْعَلْنَا مُسْتَحِقِّينَ لِرِضَاكَ وَتَحَنُّنِكَ لِنَدْعُوكَ قَائِلِينَ: اذْكُرْنَا يَا رَبُّ مَتَى جِئْتَ فِي مَلَكُوتِكَ: وَأَقْبِلْ تَوْبَةَ عَبِيدِكَ وَصَوْمَهُمْ وَصَلَوَاتِهِمْ وَقَرَابِينَهُمُ الْمَرْفُوعَةَ عَلَى مَذَابِحِكَ الْمُقَدَّسَةِ بَخُورًا طَيِّبًا وَارْحَمْهُمْ: نَسْأَلُكَ يَا رَبُّ اسْمَعْنَا وَارْحَمْنَا.

+ أَيُّهَا الْمُدَبِّرُ الْقَوِيُّ الْمُؤَدِّبُ الشَّافِي طَبِيبُ الأَرْوَاحِ وَالأَجْسَادِ: الَّذِي امْتَحَنَ عَبْدَهُ أَيُّوبَ وَشَفَاهُ مِنْ بَلَايَاهُ: وَرَدَّ عَلَيْهِ مَا فَقَدَ مِنْهُ أَزْيَدَ مِمَّا كَانَ: ارْحَمْ شَعْبَكَ وَخَلِّصْهُ مِنْ جَمِيعِ الْبَلَايَا وَالْمِحَنِ وَالتَّجَارِبِ وَالشَّدَائِدِ: يَا نَاصِرَ جَمِيعِ الْمُتَوَكِّلِينَ عَلَيْكَ: نَسْأَلُكَ يَا رَبُّ اسْمَعْنَا وَارْحَمْنَا.

+ أَيُّهَا الْمَسِيحُ إِلَهُنَا كَلِمَةُ الآبِ الَّذِي عَاهَدَ تَلَامِيذَهُ الأَطْهَارَ: وَغَسَلَ أَقْدَامَهُمْ وَجَعَلَهُمْ رُؤَسَاءَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَمَنَارًا لِلدِّينِ: وَأَشْبَعَ بِهِمِ النُّفُوسَ الْجَائِعَةَ وَعَلَّمَهُمُ الصَّلَاةَ قَائِلِينَ: أَبَانَا الَّذِي فِي السَّمَوَاتِ لَا تُدْخِلْنَا التَّجَارِبَ لَكِنْ نَجِّنَا مِنَ الشِّرِّيرِ: نَسْأَلُكَ يَا رَبُّ اسْمَعْنَا وَارْحَمْنَا.

+ يَا صَانِعَ الْعَجَائِبِ وَالْمُعْجِزَاتِ: وَمَنْ أَشْبَعَ الأُلُوفَ مِنَ الْخَمْسِ خُبْزَاتٍ وَأَقَامَ الأَمْوَاتَ وَبَارَكَ فِي الْعُرْسِ بِقَانَا الْجَلِيلِ: الآنَ أَيُّهَا السَّيِّدُ بَارِكْ لِعَبِيدِكَ فِي خُبْزِهِمْ وَزَيْتِهِمْ وَزَرْعِهِمْ وَنَحْلِهِمْ وَفِي مَتَاجِرِهِمْ وَصَنَائِعِهِمْ وَأَعْمَالِهِمْ: نَسْأَلُكَ يَا رَبُّ اسْمَعْنَا وَارْحَمْنَا.

+ يَا رَبُّ خَلِّصْ شَعْبَكَ وَاحِطْهُمْ مِنْ كُلِّ نَاحِيَةٍ بِإِشَارَةِ صَلِيبِكَ الْمُحْيِي: وَارْفَعْ شَأْنَ الْمَسِيحِيِّينَ فِي الْمَسْكُونَةِ كُلِّهَا: وَحَنِّنْ عَلَيْهِمْ قُلُوبَ الْمُتَوَلِّينَ عَلَيْهِمْ: وَعَطِّفْ قُلُوبَهُمْ عَلَى إِخْوَاتِنَا الْمَسَاكِينِ وَالْمُعْوِزِينَ بِالإِحْسَانِ وَأَبْعِدْ عَنْهُمْ كُلَّ مَكْرُوهٍ: نَسْأَلُكَ يَا رَبُّ اسْمَعْنَا وَارْحَمْنَا.

+ يَا رَبُّ يَا مَنْ تَرَكَ لَنَا عَهْدَهُ الْمُقَدَّسَ جَسَدَهُ وَدَمَهُ حَاضِرًا عِنْدَنَا كُلَّ يَوْمٍ عَلَى الْمَذْبَحِ خُبْزًا وَخَمْرًا بِحُلُولِ رُوحِ قُدُسِهِ: وَأَوْصَانَا قَائِلًا اصْنَعُوهُ لِذِكْرِي: نَسْأَلُكَ يَا رَبُّ اسْمَعْنَا وَارْحَمْنَا.

+ أَيُّهَا الْمَسِيحُ إِلَهُنَا ارْحَمْ شَعْبَكَ وَخَلِيفَةَ رُسُلِكَ: وَأَعْطِ بَرَكَةً لِثَمَرَاتِ الأَرْضِ: وَأَبْهِجْ قَلْبَ الإِنْسَانِ بِكَثْرَةِ ثَمَرَاتِ الْقَمْحِ وَالْكُرُومِ وَالزَّيْتِ: نَسْأَلُكَ يَا رَبُّ اسْمَعْنَا وَارْحَمْنَا.

+ أَيُّهَا الْمَوْلُودُ مِنَ الآبِ الَّذِي تَجَسَّدَ مِنَ الْبِكْرِ الْبَتُولِ الْعَذْرَاءِ مَرْتَمَرْيَمَ فِي آخِرِ الأَيَّامِ: الَّذِي قَالَ لِتَلَامِيذِهِ الْقِدِّيسِينَ امْضُوا وَتَلْمِذُوا كُلَّ الأُمَمِ وَعَمِّدُوهُمْ جَمِيعَ مَا أَوْصَيْتُكُمْ بِهِ: هُوَذَا أَنَا مَعَكُمْ كُلَّ الأَيَّامِ وَإِلَى انْقِضَاءِ الْعَالَمِ: كُنْ أَيْضًا مَعَ شَعْبِكَ الصَّارِخِينَ إِلَيْكَ قَائِلِينَ: نَسْأَلُكَ يَا رَبُّ اسْمَعْنَا وَارْحَمْنَا.

+ يَا غَافِرَ الْخَطَايَا وَمَانِحَ الْعَطَايَا: اغْفِرْ خَطَايَا شَعْبَكَ وَطَهِّرْهُمْ مِنْ كُلِّ دَنَسٍ وَاغْسِلْهُمْ مِنْ كُلِّ غِشٍّ: أَبْعِدْ عَنْهُمُ الْيَمِينَ الْحَانِثَةَ وَكُلَّ حَسَدٍ وَكُلَّ نَمِيمَةٍ: وَانْزِعْ مِنْ قُلُوبِهِمُ الْفِكْرَ الرَّدِيءَ وَالْوَسْوَاسَ وَكُلَّ الشُّكُوكِ وَالْكِبْرِيَاءَ وَكُلَّ قَسَاوَةٍ وَتَجَبُّرٍ: نَسْأَلُكَ يَا رَبُّ اسْمَعْنَا وَارْحَمْنَا.

+ أَنْتِ هِيَ سُورُ خَلَاصِنَا يَا وَالِدَةَ الإِلَهِ الْحِصْنُ الْمَنِيعُ غَيْرُ الْوَاقِعِ: إِلَيْكِ نَسْأَلُ مَشُورَةَ الْمُعَانِدِينَ لَنَا أَبْطِلِي: وَحُزْنَ عَبِيدِكِ إِلَى فَرَحٍ رُدِّي: وَلِمَدِينَتِنَا صُونِي: وَعَنِ الْمُلُوكِ الأُرْثُوذُكْسِيِّينَ حَارِبِي: وَعَنْ سَلَامِ الْعَالَمِ وَالْبِيَعِ اشْفَعِي: نَسْأَلُكَ يَا رَبُّ اسْمَعْنَا وَارْحَمْنَا.

+ يَا إِلَهَ الرَّحْمَةِ وَالرَّأْفَةِ وَرَبَّ كُلِّ عَزَاءٍ: لَا تَسْخَطْ عَلَيْنَا وَلَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا بِسُوءِ أَعْمَالِنَا وَلَا بِكَثْرَةِ خَطَايَانَا: وَلَا تَغْضَبْ عَلَيْنَا وَلَا يَدُمُ غَضَبُكَ إِلَى الأَبَدِ: انْصِتْ يَا إِلَهَ يَعْقُوبَ وَانْظُرْ يَا إِلَهَ عَوْنِنَا: وَارْفَعْ عَنِ الْعَالَمِ الْمَوْتَ وَالْغَلَاءَ وَالْوَبَاءَ وَالْجَلَاءَ وَسَيْفَ الأَعْدَاءِ وَالزَّلَازِلَ وَالأَهْوَالَ وَكُلَّ أَمْرٍ مُخِيفٍ: نَسْأَلُكَ يَا رَبُّ اسْمَعْنَا وَارْحَمْنَا.

+ مِنْ أَجْلِ حِفْظِنَا تَحْتَ الْيَدِ الْعَالِيَةِ الْمُقَدَّسَةِ الَّتِي لَكَ يَا اَللهُ: نَطْلُبُ إِلَيْكَ أَنْ تُبْقِيَ لَنَا وَعَلَيْنَا حَيَاةَ الأَبِ الْمُكَرَّمِ الْبَطْرِيَرْكِ أَنْبَا (فُلَانٍ): وَأَنْ تَحْفَظَ لَنَا حَيَاتَهُ وَتُثَبِّتَهُ عَلَى كُرْسِيِّهِ سِنِينَ عَدِيدَةً وَأَزْمَنَةً سَالِمَةً هَادِيَةً مَدِيدَةً: نَسْأَلُكَ يَا رَبُّ اسْمَعْنَا وَارْحَمْنَا.

+ أَيُّهَا الْمَسِيحُ إِلَهُنَا نَطْلُبُ مِنْ جُودِكَ وَمَرَاحِمِكَ الْعَالِيَةِ: أَنْ تُبْقِيَ لَنَا وَعَلَيْنَا حَيَاةَ آبَائِنَا الْمَطَارِنَةِ وَالأَسَاقِفَةِ وَكُلِّ الرُّؤَسَاءِ وَالرُّعَاةِ: احْفَظْهُمْ وَغَنَمَ رَعِيَّتِهِمْ ثَبِّتْهُمْ: أَعْطِ حِفْظًا لِلْكَهَنَةِ: طَهَارَةً لِلشَّمَامِسَةِ: قُوَّةً لِلْمَشَايِخِ: فَهْمًا لِلأَطْفَالِ: عِفَّةً لِلأَبْكَارِ: نُسْكًا لِلرُّهْبَانِ وَالرَّاهِبَاتِ: نَقَاوَةً لِلْمُتَزَوِّجِينَ: صَوْنًا لِلنِّسَاءِ: نَسْأَلُكَ يَا رَبُّ اسْمَعْنَا وَارْحَمْنَا.

+ وَأَيْضًا الضَّالِّينَ وَالْمُسَافِرِينَ رُدَّهُمْ: وَالأَرَامِلَ وَالأَيْتَامَ عُلْهُمْ: وَالْجِيَاعَ وَالْعُطَاشَ أَشْبِعْهُمْ: وَالَّذِينَ عَلَيْهِمْ دَيْنٌ أَوْفِ عَنْهُمْ وَسَامِحْهُمْ: وَالْمَحْبُوسِينَ وَالَّذِينَ فِي الشَّدَائِدِ أَفْرِجْ عَنْهُمْ: وَالْمَرْضَى اشْفِهِمْ وَالرَّاقِدِينَ نَيِّحْهُمْ: نَسْأَلُكَ يَا رَبُّ اسْمَعْنَا وَارْحَمْنَا.

+ يَا إِلَهَ آبَائِنَا الْقِدِّيسِينَ لَا تَتَخَلَّ عَنَّا: وَلَا تُخَيِّبِ الَّذِينَ خَلَقْتَهُمْ بِيَدِكَ الطَّاهِرَةِ وَأَظْهَرْتَ حُبَّكَ لِلْبَشَرِيَّةِ: أَيُّهَا الرَّحُومُ اقْبَلْ مِنْ وَالِدَتِكَ شَفَاعَةً مِنْ أَجْلِنَا وَخَلِّصْنَا: يَا مُخَلِّصُ شَعْبًا مُتَوَاضِعًا لَا تَغْفُلْ عَنَّا إِلَى الْغَايَةِ: وَلَا تُسَلِّمْنَا إِلَى الِانْقِضَاءِ: مِنْ أَجْلِ اسْمِكَ الْقُدُّوسِ لَا تَنْقُضْ عَهْدَكَ وَلَا تُبْعِدْ عَنَّا رَحْمَتَكَ: مِنْ أَجْلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَبِيبِكَ وَإِسْحَاقَ عَبْدِكَ وَيَعْقُوبَ قِدِّيسِكَ: نَسْأَلُكَ يَا رَبُّ اسْمَعْنَا وَارْحَمْنَا.
english: + We ask and entreat You, O Master Lord God the Father Almighty, and the Only-begotten Holy Son, Creator and Provider of all, and the Holy Spirit the Life-giver, the Holy Trinity before whom every knee bows, of those in heaven and those on earth, we ask You O Lord, hear us and have mercy on us.

+ For the high peace and the concord of all the churches in the world, the monasteries, the holy synods, and those dwelling therein, and for the sustaining of their affairs, O God have compassion upon Your creation and save it from every evil, we ask You O Lord, hear us and have mercy on us.

+ O You who by His power ordained the life of man before his creation, and made all things for him by His wisdom, and adorned the sky with stars, the earth with plants, trees, vines, and valleys, You now O our King, accept the petitions of Your servants standing before You, saying: we ask You O Lord, hear us and have mercy on us.

+ O God the Great and Holy, who created man in His image and likeness, and placed in him a living, rational, and speaking soul. Have mercy O Lord upon Your workmanship which You created, have compassion upon it, and send upon us Your mercy from the height of Your holiness and Your prepared dwelling, we ask You O Lord, hear us and have mercy on us.

+ O You who saved Your righteous servant Noah, and delivered him from the flood, he and his sons and their wives, and also the clean and unclean animals, for the renewal of the earth once again, we ask You O Lord, hear us and have mercy on us.

+ O Creator, provider for all. Save Your people from the flood of the sea of this passing world, and lift from them every harm. And all the animals also and all the birds, You gave them their food, for You give the beasts their food and the young ravens their sustenance, we ask You O Lord, hear us and have mercy on us.

+ O You who was a guest of Your servant Abraham the chief of the fathers, and sat at his table and blessed his seed, You now O our King, accept the petition of Your servants and priests standing before You, have compassion upon the world, save Your people from every distress, dwell in them, and walk among them, we ask You O Lord, hear us and have mercy on us.

+ We ask of You O Lord to guard us from all evils, and have compassion upon Your creation and all Your people, for the eyes of all hope in You, and You give them their food in its season. O Nourisher of every flesh. O Helper of those who have no helper. O Hope of those who have no hope, we ask You O Lord, hear us and have mercy on us.

+ O You who look upon the humble with the eye of Your care that does not slumber, and saved Joseph from his master's wife, and made him king over Egypt and its affairs, and brought him through the days of distress. So his brothers and his father Jacob came to him and bowed before him, and took from him wheat for the food of their children and their cattle. We all also bow our heads to You and worship before You, and thank You O our Creator and Provider for this state, and in every state, and for all states, and save us O God from every distress, we ask You O Lord, hear us and have mercy on us.

+ O God the Word of the Father, who worked in the Law and the Prophets and the Old Testament and completed them, save Your people from every distress, ordain their lives according to Your good will, and lift from us all drought and calamity, we ask You O Lord, hear us and have mercy on us.

+ O You who sustained the Israeli people for forty years in Mount Sinai, and they had no houses or stores. You now O my Master, preserve Your people, sustain them, and bless their homes and stores with heavenly blessings, we ask You O Lord, hear us and have mercy on us.

+ O You who accepted the petition of Elijah the Tishbite when the heavens rained and the earth brought forth, and blessed the measure of flour and the jar of oil in the widow's house, accept the petition of Your people through the prayers of Your saints and Your pure prophets, we ask You O Lord, hear us and have mercy on us.

+ O God have compassion upon the world with the eye of mercy and pity, and bless the measure of their crops and stores and the little they have, and raise the waters of the rivers to their measure, and grant moderation to the airs, and the Nile of Egypt bless it in this world and every year, and gladden the face of the earth, and sustain us humans, we ask You O Lord, hear us and have mercy on us.

+ O You who accepted the repentance of the people of Nineveh when all fasted. And accepted the confession of the thief on the right on the cross. So we, make us worthy of Your pleasure and compassion to call upon You, saying: Remember us O Lord when You come into Your kingdom. And accept the repentance of Your servants, their fasting, prayers, and offerings raised upon Your holy altars as a sweet incense, and have mercy on them, we ask You O Lord, hear us and have mercy on us.

+ O Powerful Ordainer, the Discipliner, the Healer, the Physician of souls and bodies, who tested His servant Job and healed him from his afflictions, and restored to him what he lost more than it was. Have mercy on Your people, and save them from all afflictions, trials, temptations, and distresses. O Helper of all who trust in You, we ask You O Lord, hear us and have mercy on us.

+ O Christ our God, the Word of the Father, who covenanted with His holy disciples, washed their feet, and made them leaders for the believers and a lighthouse for the religion, and satisfied with them the hungry souls, and taught them the prayer saying: Our Father who art in heaven, lead us not into temptation but deliver us from the evil one, we ask You O Lord, hear us and have mercy on us.

+ O Worker of wonders and miracles, and who satisfied the thousands from the five loaves, and raised the dead, and blessed the wedding in Cana of Galilee, now O Master, bless Your servants in their bread, oil, seed, bees, and in their trades, crafts, and works, we ask You O Lord, hear us and have mercy on us.

+ O Lord save Your people, and surround them from every side with the sign of Your life-giving cross, and elevate the status of Christians in the whole world, and incline the hearts of those in authority over them towards them, and turn their hearts to our poor and needy brethren with kindness, and keep away from them every harm, we ask You O Lord, hear us and have mercy on us.

+ O Lord, O You who left for us His holy covenant, His Body and Blood present with us every day on the altar as bread and wine by the descent of His Holy Spirit, and commanded us saying: Do this in remembrance of Me, we ask You O Lord, hear us and have mercy on us.

+ O Christ our God have mercy on Your people and the successor of Your apostles, and give a blessing to the fruits of the earth, and gladden the heart of man with the abundance of the fruits of wheat, vines, and oil, we ask You O Lord, hear us and have mercy on us.

+ O You who were born of the Father, who was incarnate of the Virgin Mary in the last days, who said to His holy disciples: Go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in all that I have commanded you. Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the world. Be also with Your people crying out to You, saying: we ask You O Lord, hear us and have mercy on us.

+ O Forgiver of sins and Giver of gifts, forgive the sins of Your people, purify them from all defilement, wash them from all deceit, keep away from them the false oath, all envy, and all gossip, and remove from their hearts the evil thought, obsession, all doubts, pride, and all hardness and tyranny, we ask You O Lord, hear us and have mercy on us.

+ You are the wall of our salvation, O Mother of God, the fortified and unshakable fortress, we ask You: the counsel of those who oppose us, abolish it. And the sorrow of Your servants, turn it into joy, and our city, protect it, and for the Orthodox kings, fight, and for the peace of the world and the churches, intercede, we ask You O Lord, hear us and have mercy on us.

+ O God of mercy and compassion, and Lord of all comfort, do not be angry with us, nor take us to task for our evil deeds, nor for the multitude of our sins, nor be wrathful with us, nor let Your anger endure forever. Listen O God of Jacob, and look O God of our help, and lift from the world death, high prices, plague, exile, the sword of enemies, earthquakes, horrors, and every fearful thing, we ask You O Lord, hear us and have mercy on us.

+ For our preservation under the high and holy Hand that belongs to You O God, we ask You to sustain for us the life of the honored father, the Patriarch Abba (Name), and to preserve his life for us and establish him on his throne for many years and safe, quiet, long times, we ask You O Lord, hear us and have mercy on us.

+ O Christ our God, we ask of Your bounty and Your high mercies to sustain for us the life of our fathers the metropolitans and bishops, and all the leaders and shepherds, preserve them and the sheep of their flock, and establish them. Grant preservation to the priests, purity to the deacons, strength to the elders, understanding to the children, chastity to the virgins, asceticism to the monks and nuns, purity to the married, and protection to the women, we ask You O Lord, hear us and have mercy on us.

+ And also the lost and travelers, return them; the widows and orphans, sustain them; the hungry and thirsty, satisfy them; those who have a debt, repay it for them and forgive them; the prisoners and those in distress, release them; the sick, heal them; and the departed, repose them, we ask You O Lord, hear us and have mercy on us.

+ O God of our holy fathers, do not abandon us, nor disappoint those whom You created with Your pure hand and showed Your love for mankind, O Merciful One, accept from Your mother an intercession for us, and save us O Savior, a humble people, do not neglect us to the end, nor deliver us to destruction, for the sake of Your holy name, do not break Your covenant, nor take away from us Your mercy, for the sake of Abraham Your beloved, Isaac Your servant, and Jacob Your saint, we ask You O Lord, hear us and have mercy on us.
